Achraf Hakimi.note: Hakimi is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Achraf Hakimi.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti.note: Watch Tagnaouti for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Amine Sbai.note: Watch Sbaï for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Amine Sbai.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Anass Salah Eddine.note: Salah-Eddine is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Anass Salah Eddine.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ayoub El Kaabi.note: Kaabi is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn.
Ayoub El Kaabi.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。

Ayoube Amaimouni.note: Watch Amaimouni-Echghouyab for explosive speed once open grass appears. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Ayoube Amaimouni.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Ayyoub Bouaddi.note: Bouaddi's edge is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Ayyoub Bouaddi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Azzedine Ounahi.note: Ounahi's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Azzedine Ounahi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Brahim Diaz.note: Díaz's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Brahim Diaz.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Chadi Riad.note: Riad's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Chadi Riad.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Chemsdine Talbi.note: Talbi's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Chemsdine Talbi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Neil El Aynaoui.note: Watch Aynaoui for creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Neil El Aynaoui.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Munir El Kajoui.note: Watch Kajoui for staying ready through long quiet spells. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Munir El Kajoui.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Bilal El Khannouss.note: Khannouss is defined by receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Bilal El Khannouss.noteZh: 他靠在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Samir El Mourabet.note: Mourabet is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Samir El Mourabet.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Zakaria El Ouahdi.note: Watch Ouahdi for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Zakaria El Ouahdi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。留意他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Gessime Yassine.note: Yassine is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Gessime Yassine.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Ismael Saibari.note: Watch Saibari for creating a better angle for the next pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ismael Saibari.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Issa Diop.summary: Issa Diop is a Morocco centre-back who plays for Fulham and adds aerial defending, physical duels, and back-line depth to the national team.
Issa Diop.note: Diop's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Issa Diop.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹上。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Marwane Saadane.note: Saâdane's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Marwane Saadane.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Noussair Mazraoui.note: Mazraoui is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Noussair Mazraoui.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Redouane Halhal.note: Halhal's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Redouane Halhal.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Sofyan Amrabat.note: Watch Amrabat for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Sofyan Amrabat.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Soufiane Rahimi.note: Rahimi's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Soufiane Rahimi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Yassine Bounou.note: Bounou stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He waits for the strike before committing. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Yassine Bounou.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Youssef Belammari.note: Watch Belammari for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Youssef Belammari.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。
